_meta.note: Modification-Center SPECIAL OFFERS (decision #35 Q1 route (a), owner 2026-08-18; docs/design/skill-tiers-proposal.md RULED). Orphan skills stay LINEAR; the ruled override mechanism for a consumption evolution they could still want is an AUTHORED Mod-Center special offer on a BROAD-ONLY pair — offered, never automatic (book §4.5: broad-only is the ask-the-GM tier; the offer IS the recorded GM call, carried as compatibility_override: true, the existing G3 machine form). Offers are NOT normal recipes: an offer's parents must share a broad group and NO narrow keyword — a narrow-shared pair belongs in data/skill_mutations.json as a normal recipe, and validate_seeds rejects it here as an authoring error (simulation/skill_forge.gd validate_offer is the engine-side twin of that gate). A roster-gated offer redemption validates through the ordinary SkillForge.validate_mutation override path — an offer row is structurally a mutation recipe. ALL THREE SHIPPED OFFERS ARE PROVISIONAL — the three data-supported candidates named by decision #35, entered awaiting the owner's blessing; result names are proposals. Min-levels are per-offer authored values (Q5 spirit; identity-primary Lv 5 + secondary Lv 3). Results are DATA-DECLARED ONLY (no skills.json rows — content-pass scope); when/where an offer appears in the Lounge flow and what it COSTS is KAN-7 pricing scope.
_meta.schema: offer: { key (unique offer id), name (display — PROVISIONAL until blessed), parents: [{key, min_level}] (>= 2 distinct skill keys sharing a BROAD group and no narrow keyword), shared_broad: [the broad group(s) the pair shares — authoring documentation, checked against the keyword data], compatibility_override: true (REQUIRED — the offer is the authored GM call past the narrow rule), result: {key, level} (not a parent key), provisional: true|false (false only after the owner blesses the offer), note }
